{"claims":[{"claim_text":"More than 11 million people are living in the United States without proper documentation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"U.S. citizens are waiting for decades to be reunited with family members.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Green card holders are waiting for years to be reunited with their spouses and minor children.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current quota system discriminates against certain immigrants, including immigrants of color.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current quota system needs to be reformed to the realities of the 21st century.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There are real questions about U.S. detention and deportation policies that must be addressed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support urgently fixing the broken immigration system.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The broken immigration system tears families apart and keeps workers in the shadows.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support creating a path to citizenship for law-abiding families who are in the United States, making a better life for their families and contributing to their communities and the country.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support repealing the 3-year, 10-year and permanent bars to immigration.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The 3-year, 10-year and permanent bars force persons in mixed status families into the dilemma of either leaving the country and their loved ones or remaining in the shadows.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work with Congress to end the forced and prolonged expulsion from the country that immigrants endure when trying to adjust their status.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
